What is RAG?
RAG retrieves relevant external context and supplies it to a language model so the answer can be grounded in source material.

How is RAG different from fine-tuning?
RAG supplies retrievable facts at inference time while fine-tuning updates model weights to improve task behavior or response patterns.

What is prompt injection in a document?
